title: Minimum F1 condition
description: Essential: The student must state or derive the condition F1 > 20 N for the plank to move upward.

title: Relative sliding condition
description: Essential: For part (2), the student must state or derive the condition F2 > 13.2 N for relative sliding.

title: Correct friction force
description: Important: The student correctly identifies the kinetic friction force as f = μF₁.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: The student applies Newton's second law correctly to both the plank and the block, setting up equations for their accelerations.

title: Simultaneous kinematic solution
description: Important: For part (3), the student correctly calculates the block's acceleration and uses kinematics to find the required time and corresponding plank height.

title: Final success determination
description: Essential: For part (3), the student must correctly conclude whether the game is successful by comparing the calculated plank height to 0.75 m.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign error when writing the net force equations (e.g., for the block: F₂ - μF₁ - mg).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student maintains consistent units (kg, m, s, N) throughout the calculation.
